name: ntxp-project-init
description: Sequences the start of a new NTXP project after asking first: environment preflight, NTXP ID, IPDM authority check, project registration, the v1.2 Drive folder tree, the Project Coda crosswalk, and model and executor choices, by calling the Forge skills that own each step. A hook offers it when a new project, bid or award is mentioned.
